## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive; mixed leadership with strong tech names ABOVE TREND but broad divergences across large caps and pockets of Consumer/Healthcare weakness, supporting a neutral read.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology leads: MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND; Sector: Technology positive (24 stocks). Materials and Financials follow: FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -2.86%) BELOW TREND. Energy soft on the week: XOM (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION and CVX (1W: -2.92% | 1M: +5.03%) CORRECTION; Utilities and Real Estate also showing weakness on 1W.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +29.05%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +6.22% | 1M: +9.76%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology) and therefore selective.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -2.86%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -0.93% | 1M: -9.93%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in consumer names and select healthcare.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: CRM (1W: +22.69%), ORCL (1W: +6.95%), ADBE (1W: +6.22%), NVDA (1W: +5.13%), MSFT (1W: +4.97%); note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across megacaps (multiple majors with 1W opposite 1M), so treat momentum as tactical not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology is positive on the week with headline leaders ABOVE TREND but several large caps show mixed shorter-term patterns: AAPL (1W: +1.05% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: -0.01% | 1M: +1.17%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth per summary: positive (Technology 1W: +3.71%).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are constructive: JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +5.04%) ABOVE TREND — sector showing steady internal support with fee/growth names holding up.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare mixed-to-soft: PFE (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND offset by LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND and UNH (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -6.07%) RECOVERY; watch insurance/coverage headlines and GLP-1 cadence for further dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective Financials and high-conviction Tech leaders while reducing exposure to clearly BELOW TREND consumer and certain healthcare names; style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration but only 5/11 sectors positive. With MAJOR DIVERGENCE in megacaps, treat new positions tactically and monitor confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND, NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +3.71%) and Materials (1W: +1.69%) — watch leadership follow-through.  
BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.40%) and Energy (1W: -1.25%) given weak 1W flows and negative sentiment in select names.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA continuation above recent swing highs would confirm tech momentum; MSFT holding current 1W gains would support broader risk appetite; AAPL failing to regain its 1M level keeps it in RECOVERY and warrants watching for trend break; LLY further downside on negative headline flow would signal deeper healthcare pause.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
V (+85): Visa (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND — news (Q2 outperformance/guidance) confirms the price move.  
BA (+60): Boeing (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND — bullish defense order headlines diverge from price, watch for sentiment-driven re-rating that so far is not confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NKE (-45): Nike (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND — bearish headlines align with price weakness.  
INTU (-45): Intuit (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION — negative take on TurboTax strategy diverges from 1M gains, monitor for follow-through.  
LLY (-45): Eli Lilly (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND — negative GLP-1 coverage headlines confirm price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership given concentrated tech winners but only 5/11 sectors positive. MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND and CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across megacaps (AAPL RECOVERY, GOOGL CORRECTION, AMZN CORRECTION) and negative headline flow on LLY and select consumer names — watch for trend breaks before expanding exposure.
